preheader: A short read on deciding well, delivering well and keeping systems healthy.

blocks.text:
Hi {{first_name}},

A few short notes on how we approach technology work, and where our practices can help.

items.title: Decide before you build
items.summary: The most expensive technology mistakes are usually made before any code is written. Vitalos Consulting helps leaders reach clear choices, a realistic roadmap and a sound architecture before they commit significant budget.

items.title: AI and data with firm foundations
items.summary: Useful AI depends on good data and careful operation. Vitalos AI & Data works from finding the right opportunities, through the foundations, to running solutions responsibly in production.

items.title: Look after what you rely on
items.summary: Software keeps delivering value only if it is maintained. Vitalos Engineering and Vitalos Managed Services build, modernise and support production systems so they stay reliable and keep improving.

blocks.text: If any of this is relevant to your work, just reply. We would be glad to hear from you.

name: Seasonal thanks
description: Neutral end-of-year message thanking clients, partners and subscribers, not tied to any particular holiday.
subject: Thank you from everyone at Vitalos
preheader: A short note of thanks as the year draws to a close.
reason: You are receiving this because you have worked with Vitalos or agreed to receive our email updates.

blocks.text:
Hi {{first_name}},

As the year draws to a close, we wanted to pause and say thank you.

Whether we have worked together, talked through an idea or kept in touch, we appreciate the time and trust you have given us. Every conversation helps us understand the challenges organisations face and how we can be more useful.

We hope the weeks ahead bring some well-earned rest, and we look forward to staying in touch in the new year.
